Store Championship events bring the excitement, prestige, and prizing of Regionals to select local gaming stores!
Check the below to learn more and find one near you!
Aim to become the Card Game Pirate King starting from here!
*Finals Invites are only awarded to North America and Europe TCG+ accounts.
*Some selected stores will be offered events for more than 64 players.
The location and the date of each Store Championship will be listed in TCG+ before player applications open.
Players can search for a store near them and apply to it through TCG+!
Find a local store on TCG+!

Once registration opens, please search for an apply to the Store Championship you want to attend on Bandai TCG+.
TCG+ is a one-stop application for Bandai Card Games that includes finding a store near to you, registering for events, tournament attendance and pairings, deck building features, and statistics.
